surfaces.rationale: Canonical coverage for bin/drain-release-worktrees (agentic-v50x), the close-out step /drain's SKILL.md step 3 now calls: one invocation releases BOTH worktrees carrying a branch (the duplicate bin/janitor refuses), unique content reaches a salvage/ ref whose tracked and untracked bytes are recoverable while the directory is still present, a merged branch is deleted while an unmerged one is retained as the archive, and neither the shared checkout nor a worktree a live session is using is ever removed. The release cases run the no-flag invocation SKILL.md prescribes against backdated fixtures, so the shipped default idle window is what protects the live worktree and what a caller must pass --idle-minutes 0 to waive; a flag missing its operand exits 64 rather than looping. The script shares bin/janitor's classification through bin/lib/worktree-classify.sh rather than copying it, so this suite and tests/test_janitor_worktree_sweep.sh exercise one decision from two callers.
